timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello everyone, Alex Noisy from Choice Provision here. We're the team behind the original
bit-trip series and right now we couldn't be more excited to announce one of the newest
things that we are working on. That's right, we're bringing our unique take on paddle-based
gameplay, rhythm music infused, spazi graphics and fun action to the legendary Breakout franchise.
And we'll be releasing this on the Intellivision Amico. Now why the Amico you may ask? Well, when
we started the studio and we were thinking about what we could do with retro video games
with these new fangled control schemes that all of these new consoles and whatnot have,
that was what really attracted us. What could we do with these new input methods? And
the good folks at the Amico came to us. They showed us the controller prototype and by Goli,
there's a weird little rotating job on there and there's an accelerometer in there and a touch
screen and the whole thing lights up and stuff. And so we were like, ooh, this is interesting,
this kind of harkens back to our roots where we wanted to do cool stuff with the controller and
indicate to you what's going on, not only with what's on the television, but also the feedback
in the controller. And so the Amico honestly just seemed like a great fit for a new experimental
abstract wacky rhythm music game that takes us all the way back to our roots. And so we couldn't
be more excited to work on breakout for the Intellivision Amico. We'll see you soon.

youtube_description:
Intellivision® is proud to show off its exclusive version of Atari®'s Breakout® only available on the Intellivision Amico™ console launching April 15, 2021.  The Intellivision Amico™ version of Breakout is being developed by the geniuses over at Choice Provisions (creators and developers of the hugely popular Bit Trip series of games) and co-published by Way Down Deep.  Although the game will start off in original "vertical mode", it won't take long to utilize the full 16:9 aspect ratio and turn things sideways! Part "block buster" and part 2D side scrolling shooter, you’ll only have a limited amount of time to get to the goal and BREAKOUT!  Players can utilize the vertical touchscreen to control the paddle and can use motion controls (once a ball is hit) to angle, aim, spin and curve in the direction that you'd like the ball to go!  Interactive music and sound design will also play an important role in this retro re-imagined experience.  And don't forget, we'll also be adding multi-player couch co-op and versus modes as well!

First released over 43 years ago in 1976, Atari®’s Breakout® arcade game was designed by Atari® co-founder Nolan Bushnell, and engineered by none other than Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak, who would of course later go on to found Apple!  Breakout® is lauded as being simple but incredibly addictive as you use your bat to bounce a ball off the bricks above in order to try and clear them all and reach the next level. You'll will now be able to take this reimagined arcade classic to the next level!  Exclusively and only on Intellivision Amico™.
